estimate.basis: reports/runpod-gpu/runs/deck-hw-smoke/ (RTX A4500) and deck-hw-full/ (RTX A5000), both live on 2026-08-14; every constant is fitted to those two runs, not estimated

command:
set -euo pipefail
ART="$RUNPOD_ARTIFACT_DIR"
TAG="w1-30-shadow-casters"
mkdir -p "$ART"
node tools/visual/deck.mjs --profile full --tag "$TAG" --gpu hardware --require-hardware --out "$ART/deck/$TAG" 2>&1 | tee -a "$ART/deck.log"
node tools/visual/deck-motion.mjs --profile full --tag "$TAG" --gpu hardware --require-hardware --every 1 --sheet-every 6 --out "$ART/motion/$TAG" 2>&1 | tee -a "$ART/motion.log"
find "$ART/motion/$TAG/frames" -name '*.png' | sort | awk 'NR % 6 != 1' | xargs -r rm -f
du -sh "$ART" | tee "$ART/return-size.txt"
